description: Modified-sandwich SettingsModel checkpoint: simple ColorScheme parsing/round-trip and non-colliding inbox+user array layering now have direct safe Rust ownership and Microsoft-derived witnesses.

entries.notes: The safe Rust ColorScheme owner parses Microsoft's full Campbell scheme including name, foreground/background, selection/cursor colors and all 16 table entries, then projects the same typed JSON object for the round-trip assertion.

The safe Rust ColorSchemeCollection layers Microsoft's inbox Campbell scheme and distinct user Campbell Powershell scheme into one two-entry collection while preserving each foreground/background value. Name collisions deliberately return an explicit deferred error until the separate collision-retargeting contracts are owned.
